steps.label: Navigate to Emergency Contact Editor
steps.note: Auth is deferred from session-launch to this step so Duo fires AFTER OCR approval. loginToUCPath is idempotent across batch items — Duo only on the first item. After filling emplId + searching, extracts the live employee name from the page header, reads existing contact names for the duplicate guard, and — on a fuzzy match (Levenshtein distance 1-2) and !dryRun — demotes the existing primary contact before re-navigating for the fill step. An exact match (distance 0) sets skipped=true and causes fill-form + save to be skipped.

operations.label: Deferred UCPath login (Duo MFA)
operations.summary: loginToUCPath(page, ctx.workflowInstance, ctx.signal) — deferred from session-launch; first item triggers Duo, subsequent items reuse warm session. Throws on auth failure.

operations.label: Open Emergency Contact deep-link URL
operations.summary: uc_deep_link=1 opens the form outside the HR Tasks iframe; all subsequent field refs land at top-level page.

operations.label: Wait for networkidle after page load
Dismiss PeopleSoft modal mask (pre-emplId fill)
operations.summary: dismissPeopleSoftModalMask — hides #pt_modalMask / .ptModalMask via JS eval before the fill.

operations.label: Dismiss PeopleSoft modal mask (pre-search click)
operations.summary: Second dismissPeopleSoftModalMask before clicking Search.

operations.label: Assert no 'No matching values' message
operations.summary: If 'No matching values were found.' is present, throws NoExistingContactError(emplId). Employee has zero contacts — Add-New path not yet implemented.

operations.label: Click Drill-in link (multi-result grid, conditional)
operations.note: Only present when search returns multiple rows. clickIfPresent — no-op if absent.

operations.label: Wait networkidle after drill-in (conditional)
operations.note: Only fires if drillInLink was clicked.

operations.label: Extract employee name from page header
operations.summary: Reads text of the element containing 'Person ID', matches regex /Person ID\s+\d+\s+([A-Za-z][A-Za-z .'-]+?)\s+Emergency Contact/. Best-effort — no-op on miss.

operations.label: Read all existing Contact Name values (duplicate guard)
operations.summary: Reads inputValue() of every Contact Name textbox on the loaded editor. Used by pickBestContactMatch (Levenshtein ≤2).

operations.label: Duplicate contact guard (Levenshtein match)
operations.summary: pickBestContactMatch on normalised names. distance=0 (exact) → sets skipped=true, skips fill-form+save. distance 1-2 (fuzzy) → demote existing primary (if !dryRun) + re-navigate. distance>2 or null → add normally.

operations.label: Re-read Contact Name inputs to locate fuzzy-match row index
operations.note: Only on fuzzy match + !dryRun. Iterates rows to find the one whose value matches existing.name.

operations.label: Uncheck Primary Contact on fuzzy-match row (demote)
operations.summary: primaryContactCheckboxes.nth(targetIndex).uncheck(). Idempotent — no-op if already unchecked.

operations.label: Save after demoting existing primary contact
Re-navigate to Emergency Contact editor after demote (fuzzy + !dryRun path)
operations.summary: Full navigateToEmergencyContact call (same sequence as ops 2-11) so fill-form starts from a clean editor showing the newly-demoted state.
operations.note: Only on fuzzy match + !dryRun. The demote and re-navigate are both inside the shouldDemoteExistingContactForRun guard (returns false on dryRun). On dryRun a fuzzy match only logs and sets fuzzyDemote='would-run'.

steps.label: Fill Emergency Contact Form
steps.note: Driven by buildEmergencyContactPlan (ActionPlan). Skipped entirely when navigation step sets skipped=true (exact duplicate found). Save is NOT part of this plan — it lives in the separate save step for accurate dashboard wall-clock timing. On dryRun, a screenshot is taken after execute() before exiting the step.

operations.label: Dismiss modal mask before Add New Row click
Click 'Add a new row at row 1' button
operations.summary: page.getByRole('button', { name: /add a new row/i }).first(). Inserts a blank row 1 above any existing contacts.

operations.label: Set Primary Contact checkbox
operations.summary: Checks if contact.primary=true (always true per form convention). check() or uncheck() based on current state vs desired.

operations.label: Select Relationship to Employee
operations.summary: page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'Relationship to Employee' }).first().selectOption({ label: relationshipLabel }). Raw relationship text is mapped via RELATIONSHIP_MAP in config.ts (e.g. 'mom'→'Parent', 'brother'→'Sibling'). Falls back to 'Other' if not in map.

operations.label: Address branch: same-as-employee vs manual address
operations.summary: wantsSameAddress = contact.sameAddressAsEmployee || !contact.address. True → check sameAddress checkbox only. False → uncheck + open Edit Address modal + fill fields + OK.

operations.label: Check 'Same Address as Employee' (same-address path)
operations.summary: page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Same Address as Employee' }).first(). Checks if not already checked.
operations.note: Same-address path only (wantsSameAddress=true). Defensive fallback also fires when sameAddressAsEmployee=false but address=null.

operations.label: Uncheck 'Same Address as Employee' (manual-address path)
operations.summary: Unchecks the checkbox to expose the address fields.

operations.label: Dismiss modal mask before Edit Address click (manual-address path)
Click 'Edit Address' button to open address modal
operations.summary: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Address' }).first().

operations.label: Fill Address 1 (street)
operations.summary: page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Address 1' }).first(). Conditional on addr.street being non-null.

operations.label: Fill City
operations.summary: page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'City' }).first(). Conditional on addr.city being non-null.

operations.label: Fill State
operations.summary: page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'State' }).first(). Conditional on addr.state being non-null.

operations.label: Fill Postal (zip)
operations.summary: page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Postal' }).first(). Conditional on addr.zip being non-null.

operations.label: Dismiss modal mask before OK click (manual-address path)
Click OK to close Edit Address modal
operations.summary: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true }).first().

operations.label: Wait 2s + networkidle after address modal OK
Fill Phone number
operations.summary: page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Phone', exact: true }).first(). Uses cellPhone || homePhone || workPhone priority. Only one Phone textbox is filled (Other Phone Numbers tab not used).
operations.note: Conditional — skipped if all three phone fields are null/empty.

steps.label: Save Emergency Contact Record
steps.note: On dryRun, save is skipped entirely and status is set to 'Dry Run Complete'. On live run, modal mask is dismissed before the Save click and networkidle guards the PeopleSoft roundtrip.

operations.label: Dry-run gate: skip save on dryRun=true
operations.summary: If record.dryRun is true, ctx.updateData({ status: 'Dry Run Complete' }) + early return. Browser state is preserved (screenshot was already taken in fill-form).

operations.label: Dismiss PeopleSoft modal mask before Save click
Click Save button
operations.summary: page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save', exact: true }).first(). Submits the completed Emergency Contact form to UCPath.

operations.label: Capture post-save screenshot
operations.summary: ctx.screenshot({ kind: 'form', label: 'emergency-contact-saved' }). Routes through structured tracker pipeline.

notes: BATCH WORKFLOW: archetype='batch', mode='sequential', preEmitPending=true, betweenItems=['reset']. Each approved OCR record becomes a daemon-queued task. betweenItems reset navigates to about:blank so a stuck UCPath page from record N doesn't leak into N+1.
DEFERRED AUTH: UCPath auth is deferred to the navigation step (deferAuth:true in systems config). This ensures Duo prompt fires AFTER the operator has reviewed OCR results — not at session launch.

DRY-RUN BOUNDARY: record.dryRun=true → fill-form plan executes (screenshot taken), save step returns early without clicking Save. Fuzzy-demote is also skipped on dryRun (shouldDemoteExistingContactForRun returns false when dryRun=true).

OCR FAN-OUT GATE: This workflow is started exclusively via /api/ocr/approve-batch with targetWorkflow='emergency-contact'. An 'operation' coordinator row is created at /api/ocr/prepare in the Emergency Contact panel; approved contact rows become operation-member children parented to the coordinator.

EXACT DUPLICATE SKIP: If findExistingContactDuplicate returns isExact=true, navigation step sets skipped=true and ctx.skipStep is called for both fill-form and save. Row records the skipReason in data.

FUZZY DEMOTE BRANCH: Levenshtein distance 1-2 on normalized names + !dryRun → demoteExistingContact (uncheck Primary Contact + save) then re-navigate so fill-form starts from the correct editor state. On dryRun, logs only.

ADD-NEW NOT IMPLEMENTED: If the employee has zero existing contacts, navigateToEmergencyContact throws NoExistingContactError (PeopleSoft shows 'No matching values'). The row records failed; batch continues.
MODAL MASK PATTERN: #pt_modalMask / .ptModalMask must be hidden via JS eval before every click. dismissPeopleSoftModalMask is called before: emplId fill, Search, Edit Address, OK, and Save.
NO FRAME REQUIRED: uc_deep_link=1 URL opens outside the HR Tasks Activity Guide iframe — all selectors use top-level page, no getContentFrame() needed.
PHONE: Only one Phone textbox is filled (cellPhone → homePhone → workPhone priority). The 'Other Phone Numbers' tab for additional phones is not used.
